name: pdf-studio
description: PDF Studio · Context Studio · Blog Studio——本地优先的读书、知识库与写作工作台（Electron）
author: xianxianxianyu

scripts.build:electron: esbuild pdfstudio/electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=pdfstudio/dist/main.mjs --external:electron && esbuild pdfstudio/electron/web-preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --outfile=pdfstudio/dist/web-preload.js --external:electron && esbuild pdfstudio/electron/shell-preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --outfile=pdfstudio/dist/shell-preload.js --external:electron
scripts.build:write: esbuild pdfstudio/web/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=pdfstudio/dist/write/main.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.app:pdfstudio: npm run build:pdfstudio && npm run build:electron && electron pdfstudio/dist/main.mjs
scripts.dist:pdfstudio: npm run build:pdfstudio && npm run build:electron && node pdfstudio/electron/write-app-package.mjs && (electron-builder --config pdfstudio/electron-builder.yml; git checkout -- package.json)
